newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical sees FDA OK for spine treatment.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical sees FDA OK for spine treatment.

text.p: United States Surgical Corp said Friday it received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for marketing a hollow cylinder that would ease spinal disease treatments.
The company said it expects permission to sell the device before year's end.
The Ray Threaded Fusion Cage is an implantable tube that could reduce operating time, tissue trauma, blood loss and pain, the company said.
It would be marketed and sold by Surgical Dynamics Inc, a U.S. Surgical subsidiary.
The company said it sees a domestic market of approximately $300 million annually for its product, with a potential international market of equal size.
It said the device was successfully used in 92 percent of 236 patients participating in the company's clinical trial.
